Shaggy, messy hair in a slate gray shade with a thick, unkempt texture. Small, squinting eyes in a pale hazel shade. A weathered face appearing in the late fifties with a rugged maturity. A heavy, bulky build. A full suit of polished steel plate armor with a dark navy blue tabard and matching cape. A wide-brimmed steel helmet and a massive iron shield.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
